title: TamedFlow: Trajectory-Aware Distillation for Teacher-Assisted Diffusion Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2610.26025v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) deliver high-fidelity image and video generation, but inference requires many sequential model evaluations. Two acceleration strategies are increasingly important: model compression makes each evaluation cheaper, while adaptive inference avoids selected teacher computation through reuse, forecasting, or speculative execution. Their combination, however, is brittle: directly applying the evaluated adaptive methods to a compressed student can degrade quality, an observed failure mode we call the \textbf{Combination Gap}. We link this gap to a mismatch between pointwise distillation and short-horizon execution: a student trained at teacher states need not remain reliable when its own predictions are chained. translated_title: TamedFlow：面向教师辅助扩散采样的轨迹感知蒸馏
translated_abstract: 摘要（arXiv:2610.26025v2，通告类型：replace-cross）：扩散Transformer（DiTs）能够实现高保真度的图像和视频生成，但推理需要多次顺序执行的模型评估。目前有两种日益重要的加速策略：模型压缩使每次评估的成本更低，而自适应推理通过复用、预测或投机执行来选择性地避免教师计算。然而，二者的组合十分脆弱：将已有的自适应方法直接应用于压缩后的学生模型会降低生成质量，我们将这种观察到的失败模式称为“组合鸿沟”。我们将这一鸿沟归因于逐点蒸馏与短视界执行之间的不匹配：在教师状态下训练的学生模型，当其自身的预测被串联执行时未必仍然可靠。我们提出TamedFlow，通过跨架构特征对齐、一个近恒等的速度对齐头以及随机化滚动监督（原文截断），针对这一实际部署角色训练压缩的DiT。
tldr: 提出TamedFlow，通过跨架构特征对齐、近恒等速度对齐头和随机化滚动监督等轨迹感知蒸馏方法，训练压缩的扩散Transformer使其在自身预测被串联执行时仍保持可靠，从而弥合模型压缩与自适应推理组合时的“组合鸿沟”。
en_tdlr: TamedFlow closes the "Combination Gap" between model compression and adaptive inference by training compressed Diffusion Transformers with trajectory-aware distillation—cross-architecture feature alignment, a near-identity Velocity Alignment Head, and randomized rollout supervision—so the student remains reliable when its own predictions are chained during sampling.
